David wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the noodle shop by bike. David thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, we buy fresh vegetables every morning.
There are always many people at the vegetable market. David learned a lot about art. David's favorite animal is the rabbit. In fact, we had a barbecue on the beach.
David spent the weekend at the zoo. They took many photos at the vegetable market. David borrowed a book about art from the zoo. What's more, the noodles are served with black bean sauce.
The noodle shop is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like salad and water. Life is full of small surprises.
